title: Ayns y valley mooar
description: Ten short, simple stories about life in the towns of the Isle of Man.

lessons.title: Yn club
lessons.summary: Daniel takes his six-year-old son Finn to see the town club play; the best player falls but gets up.
lessons.text:
Ta Finn Corkill shey bleeaney d'eash. Ta Finn as e ayr, Daniel Corkill, cummal ayns Doolish. Ta club ec y valley, as ta'n club cloie er magher mooar faggys da'n phurt.

Jiu, ta Daniel goll lesh e vac dys y vagher. Ta'n club cloie noi club veih Rhumsaa. Ta ymmodee sleih er y vagher, as ta'n ayr as e vac soie marish ny sleih elley.

She Ross Kaighin yn bluckaneyr share 'sy chlub. T'eh ard, as ta corp mooar echey. Ta queig bluckaneyryn elley ard myrgeddin, agh ta corp Ross ny smoo.

“She Ross yn bluckaneyr share,” ta Finn gra rish e ayr.

Ayns y chied ayrn jeh'n chloie, huitt Ross er y vagher. Va Finn jeeaghyn er. Huitt eh daa cheayrt, agh dirree eh, as ghow eh toshiaght dy chloie.

Ayns yn ayrn jerrinagh jeh'n chloie, chossyn Doolish. Va queig ec Doolish as daa ec Rhumsaa. She yn laa jerrinagh jeh'n vlein son y club.

Lurg y chloie, haink Ross dys Finn as e ayr. Hug eh e laue da Finn.

“Vel oo cloie?” dooyrt Ross.

“Cha nel,” dooyrt Finn. “Agh ta mee shey bleeaney d'eash, as bee mee cloie son y club!”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Finn shey bleeaney d'eash?
Ta. Ta Finn shey bleeaney d'eash.
Hie Daniel lesh e vac dys y vagher?
Hie. Hie eh lesh Finn dys y vagher faggys da'n phurt.
Huitt Ross er y vagher?
Huitt. Huitt eh ayns y chied ayrn jeh'n chloie.
Chossyn Doolish y chloie?
Chossyn. Va queig ec Doolish as daa ec Rhumsaa.

lessons.title: Yn thie bee beg
lessons.summary: Old Neil is closing his little café in Ramsey; Megan, who has only a little money, takes it on and opens it again.
lessons.text:
Ta thie bee beg ec Neil Cowley ayns Rhumsaa. Rish 40 blein, va Neil ec y claare 'sy thie bee dagh laa. Ta ymmodee sleih çheet dys y thie bee, as ta Neil cur bee daue.

Nish, ta Neil shenn. “Ta mee goll dy ghooney yn thie bee,” t'eh gra rish Megan Corrin. “Ta mee faagail Rhumsaa, as ta mee goll dys Nerin.”

Ta Megan goll dys y thie bee dagh laa. “Cha by vie lhiam y thie bee y ve dooint,” t'ee gra. “She'n thie bee share 'sy valley eh.”

“Vel argid ayd?” ta Neil gra.

“Ta beggan argid aym,” ta Megan gra. “Agh cha nel wheesh argid aym as t'ayd.”

“Cha nel mee laccal wheesh argid,” ta Neil gra. “Gow yn thie bee son beggan argid. Ta tasht mooar dy vee 'sy thie bee. Jean ymmyd jeh'n tasht.”

Daag Neil y thie bee as y claare ec Megan. Va'n thie bee dooint son un laa. Yn laa ny yei, va Megan ec y claare. Va'n thie bee foshlit reesht, as haink ny sleih reesht.

Nish, ta Megan cur bee da ny sleih dagh laa.

Feyshtyn:
Row Neil ec y claare rish 40 blein?
Va. Va Neil ec y claare 'sy thie bee rish 40 blein.
Vel Neil faagail Rhumsaa?
Ta. T'eh faagail Rhumsaa, as t'eh goll dys Nerin.
Row ram argid ec Megan?
Cha row. Cha row agh beggan argid eck.
Vel y thie bee foshlit reesht?
Ta. Nish, ta Megan ec y claare, as ta'n thie bee foshlit reesht.

lessons.title: Yn reihys
lessons.summary: Young Fiona stands in the Douglas election for a new law on housing and wins over Liam, an old man who distrusts politicians.
lessons.text:
Ta reihys ayns Doolish. Ta Fiona Qualtrough ayns y reihys. T'ee aeg: t'ee 24 bleeaney d'eash. She oltey ee jeh partee politickagh noa.

Ta Fiona credjal dy vel leigh noa scanshoil. “Cha nel thieyn ec sleih aeg 'sy valley,” t'ee gra. “Ta leigh noa mie son sleih theayagh, as son sleih aeg.”

Dagh laa, ta Fiona goll mygeayrt y valley. T'ee inshey da ny sleih mychione y leigh noa.

Ta Liam Gell shenn. “Cha nel mee credjal sleih politickagh,” t'eh gra. “T'ad ooilley gra reddyn mie roish y reihys. Lurg y reihys, t'ad ayns oik, as cha nel ad jannoo red erbee.”

Ta Fiona soie marish Liam. T'ee inshey da mychione y leigh as mychione ny thieyn. Ta Liam as Fiona loayrt rish traa liauyr.

Ec y jerrey, ta Liam gra: “Ta mee credjal dy vel y leigh mie. She sleih theayagh shin ooilley.”

Laa yn reihys, ren ymmodee sleih reih Fiona, sleih aeg as sleih shenn. Chossyn ee! Nish, ta Fiona ayns oik.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Fiona aeg?
Ta. T'ee aeg: t'ee 24 bleeaney d'eash.
Vel Fiona credjal dy vel y leigh noa scanshoil?
Ta. T'ee credjal dy vel y leigh mie son sleih theayagh.
Ren Fiona inshey da Liam mychione y leigh?
Ren. Ren ee inshey da mychione y leigh as ny thieyn.
Chossyn Fiona y reihys?
Chossyn. Nish, t'ee ayns oik.

lessons.title: Yn scoill mooie
lessons.summary: Teacher Rory takes the children of a Ramsey school to a glen, where Zoe finds a green frog.
lessons.text:
Jiu, cha nel ny paitçhyn ayns y scoill. T'ad mooie! Ta Rory Moore, fer-ynsee ayns Rhumsaa, goll lesh 15 paitçhyn dys glion faggys da'n valley.

Ta'n glion goll veih'n slieau sheese dys y choose. Ta keyll ayns y glion, as ta ny biljyn glass. Ta ushtey roie trooid y cheyll, veih'n slieau dys y vooir.

“Ta ymmodee baaghyn ayns y cheyll,” ta Rory gra rish ny paitçhyn. “Jeeagh-jee er ny biljyn, as jeeagh-jee 'syn ushtey.”

Ta Zoe Looney, paitçhey shey bleeaney d'eash, jeeaghyn 'syn ushtey. Ta rannag ghlass ayn.

“Jeeagh!” t'ee gra. “Rannag! Vel ee bio?”

“T'ee bio,” ta Rory gra. “Ta'n rannag ny baagh beg. T'ee cummal 'syn ushtey as er y thalloo.”

Ta ny paitçhyn jeeaghyn er y rannag. Ec y jerrey, ta'n rannag goll stiagh 'syn ushtey.

Lurg shen, ta ny paitçhyn goll sheese dys y choose. Ta'n coose ard, as ta'n vooir mooar.

“S'mie lhiam y scoill mooie,” ta Zoe gra. “T'ee share na'n scoill 'sy thie!”

Feyshtyn:
Vel ny paitçhyn mooie jiu?
Ta. T'ad mooie ayns glion faggys da Rhumsaa.
Vel y glion goll veih'n slieau dys y choose?
Ta. T'eh goll veih'n slieau sheese dys y choose.
Vel ny biljyn glass?
Ta. Ta keyll ayns y glion, as ta ny biljyn glass.
Vel y rannag bio?
Ta. T'ee bio, as t'ee cummal 'syn ushtey as er y thalloo.

lessons.title: Yn conaant
lessons.summary: Peel's council signs a twinning agreement with a French commune, and Luke translates between French and English.
lessons.text:
Ta Pheeil ny baljaght er coose heear Ellan Vannin. Ta coonseil ec y valjaght, as ta Sophie Crennell ny eaghtyrane jeh'n choonseil.

Jiu, ta'n coonseil jannoo conaant lesh commyoon ayns y Rank. She Kerlouan ennym y commyoon. Ta sleih veih'n commyoon çheet dys Pheeil son y conaant.

Cha nel Frangish ec Sophie. Agh ta Luke Kermeen ny loayreyder Frangish. T'eh çhyndaa veih Frangish gys Baarle, as veih Baarle gys Frangish.

“Ta'n conaant scanshoil son cultoor,” ta eaghtyrane y commyoon gra ayns Frangish. Ta Luke çhyndaa ny focklyn gys Baarle.

“Ta,” ta Sophie gra. “Ta'n cultoor ain as y cultoor eu cosoylagh: kiaull, bee as glare.”

Ta dagh baljagh ayns Pheeil çheet dys y phurt. Ta kiaull ayn, as ta bee ayn. She baljagh jeh Pheeil Luke, as t'eh soilshaghey y valjaght da sleih y commyoon.

Ec y jerrey, ta Sophie as eaghtyrane y commyoon screeu nyn enmyn er y conaant. Nish, ta Pheeil as Kerlouan kianglt ry-cheilley.

Feyshtyn:
Vel coonseil ec Pheeil?
Ta. Ta coonseil ec y valjaght, as ta Sophie ny eaghtyrane.
Vel Luke ny loayreyder Frangish?
Ta. T'eh çhyndaa veih Frangish gys Baarle.
Vel y conaant scanshoil son cultoor?
Ta. Ta'n conaant scanshoil son cultoor: kiaull, bee as glare.
Ren Sophie screeu e ennym er y conaant?
Ren. Ren ee screeu e ennym er y conaant.

lessons.title: Feaill 'sy agglish
lessons.summary: At a festival of traditional music in a Ramsey church, the singer Ellie cannot sing at first, then sings in Manx and English.
lessons.text:
Ta agglish shenn ayns Rhumsaa. Dagh blein, ta feaill ayns yn agglish: feaill son kiaull tradishoonagh.

Jiu, ta Ellie Karran goll dys feaill yn agglish. She arraneyder ee. T'ee goaill arraneyn tradishoonagh ayns Gaelg, as ayns Baarle neesht.

Ta ymmodee sleih ayns yn agglish. Ta Ellie ec kione yn agglish. T'ee foshley e beeal, agh cha nel sheean erbee çheet ass e beeal.

Ta Josh Kewish, dooinney shenn, soie faggys. “Ta Gaelg ec ymmodee sleih ayns yn agglish,” t'eh gra. “Gow yn arrane ayns Gaelg hoshiaght.”

Ta Ellie goaill yn arrane ayns Gaelg. Ta'n sheean sollys as mie. Ta ny sleih elley goaill yn arrane neesht.

Lurg shen, ta Ellie goaill arrane ayns Baarle.

Lurg shen, ta Josh gra rish Ellie: “Ta kiaull tradishoonagh mie son yn annym. Ta'n kiaull ayd çheet veih'n annym.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel feaill ayns yn agglish dagh blein?
Ta. Ta feaill son kiaull tradishoonagh ayn dagh blein.
Vel Ellie ny arraneyder?
Ta. She arraneyder ee.
Row sheean çheet ass beeal Ellie ec y toshiaght?
Cha row. Cha row sheean erbee çheet ass e beeal.
Ren Ellie goaill arrane ayns Gaelg?
Ren. Ren ee goaill arrane ayns Gaelg, as ayns Baarle neesht.

lessons.title: Yn coorse giare
lessons.summary: Amy from Ramsey spends six days on a short Manx course at the university in Douglas and learns about the verb.
lessons.text:
Ta Amy Mylrea cummal ayns Rhumsaa. T'ee goll dys coorse 'syn ollooscoill ayns Doolish. Ta Doolish foddey veih Rhumsaa, son ta'n raad liauyr. Myr shen, ta Amy cummal ayns Doolish son y coorse, as t'ee scarrit veih e lught-thie.

She coorse Gaelg eh. Ta'n coorse giare: cha nel eh agh shey laghyn. Agh dagh laa, ta Amy ynsaghey rish y slane laa.

Ta Jack Taubman ny fer-ynsee ayns yn ollooscoill. Cha nel eh lhiggey da ny sleih loayrt Baarle 'sy choorse. “Ta Gaelg lhiggit, agh cha nel Baarle lhiggit!” t'eh gra.

“Jiu, ta shin ynsaghey mychione yn abbyrlhit,” ta Jack gra. “Ayns Gaelg, ta'n abbyrlhit ec toshiaght y raa: ‘Ta Amy ayns yn ollooscoill.’ She ‘ta’ yn abbyrlhit.”

Ta Amy screeu raa giare: “Hie Amy dys Doolish.” She ‘hie’ yn abbyrlhit. Lurg shen, ta Amy screeu slane duillag ayns Gaelg.

Ec y jerrey jeh'n choorse, ta Amy goll dys y thie. Cha nel ee scarrit veih e lught-thie ny smoo.

“Ta Doolish foddey veih Rhumsaa,” t'ee gra, “agh bee mee goll dys yn ollooscoill reesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel y coorse giare?
Ta. Cha nel y coorse agh shey laghyn.
Vel Doolish foddey veih Rhumsaa?
Ta. Ta Doolish foddey veih Rhumsaa, son ta'n raad liauyr.
Vel Baarle lhiggit 'sy choorse?
Cha nel. Ta Gaelg lhiggit, agh cha nel Baarle lhiggit.
Vel yn abbyrlhit ec toshiaght y raa ayns Gaelg?
Ta. Ayns Gaelg, ta'n abbyrlhit ec toshiaght y raa.

lessons.title: Reddyn oaylleeagh
lessons.summary: In a hall in Douglas, Ronan shows the townspeople atoms, the planets and the sun, and Lucy asks about the continents.
lessons.text:
Ta Ronan Vondy jannoo obbyr oaylleeagh. Jiu, t'eh ayns thie mooar ayns Doolish, as t'eh taishbyney reddyn oaylleeagh da sleih y valley.

“Ta dagh red jeant jeh breneenyn,” t'eh gra. “Ta breneenyn ayns ushtey, ayns aer, as ayns dooinney. Cha nel shin fakin breneen, son t'ee feer, feer beg.”

Ta Ronan taishbyney jalloo jeh'n chruinney. “She planaid ee y chruinney,” t'eh gra. “Ta'n chruinney gorrym, son ta'n keayn mooar. Ta'n keayn eddyr ny corocklyn.”

“Vel 7 corocklyn ayn?” ta Lucy Cretney gra.

“Ta,” ta Ronan gra. “Ta 7 corocklyn ayn. Ta Ellan Vannin faggys da corockle mooar.”

Lurg shen, t'eh taishbyney jalloo jeh'n ghrian. “Ta'n chruinney goll mygeayrt y ghrian,” t'eh gra. “Ta planaidyn elley goll mygeayrt y ghrian myrgeddin. She rollage ee y ghrian.”

Ec y jerrey, t'eh taishbyney jalloo jeh slieau. “Cha nel yrjid mooar ec ny sleityn ayns Ellan Vannin,” t'eh gra. “Agh ta yrjid feer vooar ec ny sleityn ayns corocklyn elley.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel dagh red jeant jeh breneenyn?
Ta. Ta breneenyn ayns ushtey, ayns aer as ayns dooinney.
Vel y chruinney ny planaid?
Ta. She planaid ee y chruinney.
Vel y chruinney gorrym?
Ta. T'ee gorrym, son ta'n keayn mooar.
Vel y chruinney goll mygeayrt y ghrian?
Ta. Ta'n chruinney goll mygeayrt y ghrian.

lessons.title: Ny raaidyn er yn eggey
lessons.summary: Holly puts a picture of the Douglas road network on the web; when a road is closed, Noah sees it and takes another way.
lessons.text:
Ta Holly Joughin cummal ayns çheshvean Doolish. T'ee jannoo jalloo jeh moggyl raaidyn y valley son yn eggey.

Ayns y jalloo, ta dagh raad ny linney. Ta ny raaidyn mooarey nyn linnaghyn gorrym, as ta ny raaidyn beggey nyn linnaghyn jiarg. Ta shiartanse dy raaidyn mooarey goll veih'n çheshvean dys y phurt.

Ta Holly screeu lhiurid dagh raad ayns y jalloo. Ta lhiurid mooar ec y raad dys Rhumsaa, as ta lhiurid beg ec ny raaidyn 'sy çheshvean.

Haghyr red noa 'sy valley jiu. Va'n raad mooar ec y phurt dooint. Ta Holly cur y red noa er yn eggey: ta'n linney gorrym ec y phurt jiarg nish.

Ta Noah Quiggin sthie 'sy thie. T'eh goll dys y phurt jiu. T'eh jeeaghyn er yn eggey hoshiaght. T'eh fakin y moggyl, as t'eh fakin dy vel y raad ec y phurt dooint.

Ta shiartanse dy raaidyn elley ayn. Ta Noah goaill raad elley trooid y çheshvean.

“Ta'n moggyl er yn eggey mie,” t'eh gra. “Ta fys aym nish er dagh red ta taghyrt 'sy valley.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Holly cummal ayns çheshvean Doolish?
Ta. T'ee cummal ayns çheshvean Doolish.
Vel dagh raad ny linney 'sy jalloo?
Ta. Ta dagh raad ny linney, gorrym ny jiarg.
Haghyr red noa 'sy valley jiu?
Haghyr. Va'n raad mooar ec y phurt dooint.
Ren Noah jeeaghyn er yn eggey?
Ren. Va Noah sthie 'sy thie, as ren eh jeeaghyn er yn eggey.

lessons.title: Yn jalloo yiarn
lessons.summary: Oscar and Ella take the cover off an old iron statue by the harbour and paint it blue, getting paint on their skin.
lessons.text:
Ta jalloo yiarn shenn ayns Doolish, faggys da'n phurt. She jalloo jeh dooinney lesh eeast eh. Ta'n jalloo shassoo ayns shen rish 100 blein.

Ta'n yiarn shenn, as cha nel daah mie er y jalloo nish. Jiu, ta Oscar Sayle as Ella Duggan goll dy chur daah noa er y jalloo.

Ta coodagh mooar er y jalloo. Ta Oscar as Ella tayrn y coodagh jeh'n jalloo.

“Ta shin cur daah gorrym er y yiarn,” ta Ella gra. “Ta'n daah freayll y yiarn mie. Cha nel ushtey as aer y vooir mie son yiarn.”

Ta Oscar skeayley yn daah er y yiarn. Ta'n daah skeayley er e laueyn as er e chrackan neesht.

“Jeeagh er y crackan ayd!” ta Ella gra. “T'eh gorrym!”

Ec y jerrey jeh'n laa, ta'n jalloo gorrym as noa. Ta Oscar as Ella tayrn y coodagh harrish y jalloo reesht. Ta'n jalloo yiarn shassoo ec y phurt, as ta'n daah noa freayll eh.

Feyshtyn:
Vel y jalloo yiarn shassoo faggys da'n phurt?
Ta. T'eh shassoo ayns shen rish 100 blein.
Ren Oscar as Ella tayrn y coodagh jeh'n jalloo?
Ren. Ren ad tayrn y coodagh mooar jeh'n jalloo.
Vel y daah freayll y yiarn mie?
Ta. Ta'n daah freayll y yiarn mie.
Row daah er crackan Oscar?
Va. Va daah gorrym er e chrackan.
